checks.title: Confirm gate goal and owner
checks.instructions: Name the exact release decision, QA and release owners, first review result, status authority, deadline, and excluded merge or deploy actions.

checks.title: Bind exact candidate
checks.instructions: Record release or PR ID, SHA, immutable build artifact, environment, journey and policy revisions, cutoff, and stable attempt IDs. A branch name or green summary is not candidate identity.

checks.title: Enumerate required evidence
checks.instructions: Record every required suite, mandatory assertions, pass/fail/blocked and needs-review rules, waiver authority, retry limits, and treatment of skipped or stale results.

checks.title: Set browser and retention policy
checks.instructions: Verify test account and fixtures, runner, expected journey, screenshots/video/console/network requirements, retention and sensitive-data handling.

checks.title: Bind ready QA Crews
checks.instructions: Inspect compatible existing Crews. Bind ready Browser Journey QA Analyst and Release Quality Assistant IDs and selected skills. Add Flaky Test Investigator only when intermittent evidence needs a distinct diagnosis owner.

checks.title: Probe real source access
checks.instructions: Read one exact candidate record, its required-suite policy, an actual attempt and diagnostics, and destination state if publication is proposed. A provider name is not verified access.

checks.title: Validate selected handoffs
checks.instructions: Run the bundled validator before Gate consumes Journey or optional Flake artifacts. Reject mismatched SHA/build/environment, missing required evidence, hidden failed attempts, unreviewed waivers, and a pass with missing suites.

checks.title: Review the concrete Automation
checks.instructions: Show Crew IDs, runner/source and artifact paths, explicit validator steps, optional flake branch, gate owner and waiver boundaries, status publication route, duplicate rule, cost, and manual route before Builder applies it.

checks.title: Run one candidate manually
checks.instructions: Use a real authorized candidate and policy. Save exact attempt and validator results, gate owner decision, publication receipt or none, and blockers. Fixtures alone do not complete setup.

checks.title: Choose event and status policy
checks.instructions: Keep manual-only or review an authenticated build event with stable release/build/run IDs, replay behavior, retry/cost limits, and notifications. Setup completion alone does not publish a status or approve release.
